basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old puzzle enthusiast hailing from Seattle, WA. By day, I work as a software developer for a tech startup, and by night, I'm often found diving deep into online communities revolving around puzzles and games. My interests include mobile gaming, particularly Puzzle & Dragons, as well as cybersecurity, which ties into my fascination with subreddits like Malware. I'm an early riser and usually online between 6-8 AM and 8-11 PM. When I'm not working or gaming, I enjoy hiking and exploring the Pacific Northwest with my partner. I'm in a long-term relationship and we share a love for both the outdoors and a variety of board games.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from the University of Washington and have been coding since my teenage years. My professional focus has been on software development, but I also dedicate time to understanding the latest in cybersecurity through self-study and participation in online forums. My passion for puzzles and logical challenges has naturally led me to communities like PuzzleAndDragons, where I not only play but also engage with others to exchange strategies and tips.
